atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept / style-transfer. Asset: tiny tabletop hotbar glyph candidates. Create ONE square atlas in NINE EQUAL cells, a strict 3x3 row-major grid, without drawn grid lines or cell labels. PURE SOLID WHITE #FFFFFF silhouettes on perfectly clean PURE BLACK #000000. Reference 1 supplies the approved WHITE-GLYPH STYLE ONLY; do not copy its subjects. Each icon must fit in the central 60 percent of its own cell, leaving at least 20 percent black margin on every side. No part may cross a cell boundary. All human heads, feet, hands and tool ends must remain complete. Broad sober stencil shapes, generous large negative spaces, minimal featureless faces and natural adult anatomy, readable at 64, 32 and 16 px. No gray, shading, gradients, texture, hatching, dithering, speckles, distressed edges, thin hair or fabric detail, labels, initials, numerals, border or watermark. No anime, heroic faces, chibi, giant generic cogs, playful arrows, gore or monsters. This is a PLAYER HUMAN action set: no harpies, birds, bees, wings or machine anatomy. The three variations of the selected two-person concept must offer genuinely distinct readable concepts or poses, not three copies. No pictorial text anywhere.

Reference 1 is WHITE-GLYPH STYLE ONLY. Reference 2 is the GM-SELECTED TWO-PERSON CONCEPT to develop, not a request to repeat it unchanged. Keep its two people and the withdrawing person's awareness of the opponent. The core distinction is CONTROLLED DISENGAGE WITHOUT AN OPENING FOR A FREE STRIKE, rather than turning away and fleeing. No successful strike is shown.
GM feedback, verbatim: Create more versions of the same concept. Two people in close combat, with one retreating. Think up of some way to show that this won't trigger an attack of opportunity. That is - this is a controlled disengage rather than a flee.
ROW-MAJOR CONTENTS:
1. TWO ordinary adult humans in a CONTROLLED MELEE DISENGAGE, full-body side view. LEFT person FACES RIGHT at their opponent and takes a short balanced BACKWARD STEP LEFT. Their front forearm stays upright between their face and the opponent, the other hand protects the ribs. RIGHT opponent extends one bent arm toward them, but its hand stops SHORT OF THE GUARD with a clear black gap. Both people remain calm and balanced. Retreating person's face NEVER turns away; no running posture. The maintained guard closes the opening for a free strike. No successful hit, no weapon, shield or extra symbol. Preserve the selected reference's two-person concept with a more clearly backward-stepping and guarded defender.
2. TWO ordinary adult humans in CLOSE MELEE, a CONTROLLED DISENGAGE. LEFT person FACES RIGHT while stepping BACK LEFT. Their lead OPEN PALM gently CHECKS the opponent's reaching WRIST, guiding that arm to the OUTSIDE and AWAY from their torso; their other hand remains raised in guard. The RIGHT opponent faces LEFT, arm extended but not striking the retreating person's body. One clear hand-to-wrist contact only; keep both arms anatomically distinct using a wide black notch at the contact. Head and torso of the withdrawing person stay behind their own guard. No grabbing contest, throw, punch, running away, fleeing turned back, successful hit, weapon or shield. Show safe withdrawal through maintained defensive control, not an attack by the retreating person.
3. TWO ordinary adult humans in CLOSE MELEE, LEFT person FACING RIGHT at the opponent while taking a measured BACKWARD STEP LEFT, both hands in protective guard. RIGHT opponent FACES LEFT with one arm ready, no blow landing. Both are standing with natural short steps, never running or turning their back. ABOVE THE BLACK GAP BETWEEN THE TWO FIGURES place ONE SMALL SIMPLE PROHIBITED-STRIKE pictogram: a plain white circular ring containing one short attack stroke, crossed by ONE stout diagonal bar. This is a sober functional no-free-strike notation, not a physical shield, magic barrier or third character. Keep the symbol smaller than the two heads together but bold enough to read. The two human figures and their controlled retreat remain the main subject. No letters, numbers, arrows, fists floating separately, weapons, impact star or successful hit.
CELLS 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 AND 9 MUST REMAIN PURE BLACK AND COMPLETELY EMPTY. Only the TOP ROW contains the THREE variations. No filler.
